consequence: Turning an engine off hides nothing: each scan says «not run (disabled)» for it, and what it found stays open, never marked fixed. Changes apply from the next scan.
uncovered: No engine that is on checks {{what}}: scans say so, and what was found there before stays open.

code.title: Code and dependencies
code.description: What your code does and the packages it brings in.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Keys, tokens and passwords committed to a repository.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure and CI
infrastructure.description: Terraform, Kubernetes, Dockerfiles and CI pipelines.

images.title: Images
images.description: Container image packages; Trivy, above, reads their configuration and secrets too.

web.title: Web
web.description: What your verified domains show anyone. Nothing here attacks a site.

opengrep.adds: SAST with Pitangus rules for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, PHP, Ruby and C#.

trivy.adds: Dependencies of any ecosystem, infrastructure as code, secrets and container images.
trivy.covers: dependencies, infrastructure as code, secrets or images

osv_scanner.adds: Dependencies against the OSV database, with more manifest formats (.NET, Gradle, uv).

betterleaks.adds: High-precision secrets, in the code and in credential files.

checkov.adds: More Terraform, CloudFormation and Dockerfile checks, and pipelines beyond GitHub Actions.
checkov.covers: those extra infrastructure and pipeline checks

zizmor.adds: GitHub Actions in depth: template injection, dangerous triggers and permissions.

grype.adds: A second opinion on image packages, next to Trivy.
grype.covers: image packages with a second opinion

httpx.adds: The technologies and versions each host shows, and the status of the pages reached.

testssl.adds: Each host's TLS configuration and certificate.

nuclei.adds: Detection-only templates: exposed files, misconfigurations and takeovers.

dast.title: Full web scan
dast.adds: Experimental. ZAP crawls verified domains passively and subfinder finds related hosts; it never attacks.

katana.adds: A crawler whose URLs feed ZAP and nuclei in the full web scan.

confirm.dast_title: Turn on the full web scan?
